## On-demand model delegation

This release adds `harness-gemini-agent`, `harness-claude-agent`, and `harness-codex-agent`, backed by one `harness-agent` command. Operators and authorized parent agents can delegate work with native tools, streamed progress, durable results, exact-session continuation, and cancellation.

Repository setup and upgrades install these skills as the default route for cross-model access. Hosts choose their own available models and effort settings. Routine governance checks do not invoke models. Implementation-plan model assignments remain separate work.

## Gemini validation exception

The operator explicitly authorized publishing 2.4.0 before Gemini live validation was completed. Provider quota exhaustion prevented Gemini's live read/edit/command/web acceptance and Gemini-parent routing checks. Gemini has deterministic adapter and lifecycle coverage; its full live capability and parent-routing acceptance remain unverified for this release.

Codex and Claude have live capability evidence, including Claude delegating to Codex. The five accepted secondary-review findings were repaired and independently rechecked. The Gemini exception does not waive automated source-readiness, wheel, process, or publication checks. Complete the deferred Gemini checks when model access is available.

## Adoption

Existing repositories retain their pinned runtime until deliberately upgraded to 2.4.0. Provider installations and authentication remain optional host prerequisites. The new wrappers support macOS and Linux; native Windows provider execution is not supported.
